<p style="text-align: justify;">
I am on the 2026–27 academic job market. My research sits at the intersection of macroeconomics, credit markets, and banking — combining theory with empirical analysis to understand how household and bank balance sheets shape the transmission of monetary and fiscal policy. Below you will find everything a committee needs; please [email me](mailto:juan.zurita@ed.ac.uk) with any questions.
